usage.title: Usage Analytics
usage.subtitle: Monitor your API usage, costs, and token consumption patterns
usage.chartDailySpendSub: Staking credits vs. paid balance over time
usage.chartTokenVolumeSub: Input and output tokens consumed daily
usage.helpTokenBody: Tokens are calculated based on the model's tokenizer. Input tokens are the prompt, and output tokens are the generated response. Different models have different pricing per token.
usage.helpCostBody: Costs are split between staking credits (if available) and paid balance. Staking credits are always used first to minimize your out-of-pocket expenses.
usage.helpRetentionBody: Usage data is retained for 12 months. You can export your data at any time for your records or analysis.
usage.helpTrackingBody: Each request is associated with an API key, allowing you to track usage across different applications or team members.
usage.exportSubtitle: View and export your complete API usage history
usage.exportSearchPlaceholder: Search by model, endpoint, or request ID...
usage.exportNoMatch: No usage records match your search criteria.
usage.exportNoData90: No API usage found in the last 90 days.
usage.exportInfoDefault: The table shows the last 90 days of API usage data by default.
usage.exportInfoSearch: Use the search box to filter by model name or endpoint
usage.exportInfoCsv: Click "Download CSV" to export all filtered records to a spreadsheet.
usage.exportInfoSplit: Costs are split between staking credits (green) and paid balance (blue).
